_comment: Seed example sentences (controller §8: 6–10). Eight sentences, original text written
NOT Tatoeba. Controller §8 names a filtered Tatoeba subset (CC BY 2.0 FR, per-sentence
attribution) as the intended source, but tatoeba.org and downloads.tatoeba.org were
both unreachable from this build session, so no real sentence could be retrieved and
no contributor could be credited. Inventing sentence ids and usernames to make the
dataset look sourced would be fabrication, so these are original compositions instead
and the Tatoeba subset is recorded as deferred item D-2 in LICENSES.md.
lexemeIds and constructionIds are referential — test/dataset.test.ts fails on a
dangling id, and checks that each linked lexeme's kanji stem really occurs in the
sentence (stem, not headword, so inflected forms still match).

records.japanese: 線路はこの先で二つに分かれる。
records.english: The railway line splits in two just beyond here.

records.japanese: 分岐点まで来て、右の道を行くことにした。
records.english: Having come as far as the fork, I decided to take the road on the right.

records.japanese: 岐路に立ったときは、自分で決めるしかない。
records.english: When you are standing at a crossroads, there is nothing for it but to decide for yourself.

records.japanese: この部分がまだよく分からない。
records.english: I still don't really understand this part.

records.japanese: 駅の前で道路が三つに分かれている。
records.english: In front of the station the road divides into three.

records.japanese: 車道と線路が並んで続いている。
records.english: The roadway and the railway line run on side by side.

records.japanese: 五分後に駅に着きます。
records.english: We arrive at the station in five minutes.

records.japanese: その道を行くかどうか、まだ決めていない。
records.english: I still haven't decided whether to take that road.
